acrobat.description: Each night*, choose a player: if they are or become drunk or poisoned tonight, you die.

alchemist.description: You have a Minion ability. When using this, the storyteller may prompt you to choose differently.
lore_desc: You have a Minion ability.
When using this, the storyteller may
ask you to choose differently.

alsaahir.description: Each day, if you publicly guess which players are Minion(s) and which are Demon(s), good wins.

amnesiac.description: You do not know what your ability is. Each day, privately guess what it is: learn how accurate you are.

artist.description: Once per game, during the day, you may privately ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.
lore_desc: Once per game, during the day, you may
privately ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.

atheist.description: The Storyteller can break the game rules, and if executed, good wins, even if you are dead. [No evil characters]

balloonist.description: Each night, you learn a player of a different character type than last night. [+0 or +1 Outsider]

banshee.description: If the demon kills you, all players learn this. From now on, you may nominate twice per day and vote twice per nomination.

bountyhunter.description: You start knowing 1 evil player. If the player dies, you learn another evil player tonight. [1 Townsfolk is evil]

cannibal.description: You have the ability of the recently killed executee. If they are evil, you are poisoned until a good player dies by execution.
lore_desc: You have the ability of the recently killed executee.
If they are evil, you are poisoned until
a good player dies by execution.

chambermaid.description: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.
lore_desc: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself):
learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.

chef.description: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.
lore_desc: Start knowing how many
pairs of evil players there are.

choirboy.description: If the Demon kills the King, you learn which player is the Demon. [+the King]

clockmaker.description: You start knowing how many steps from the Demon to its nearest Minion.
lore_desc: Start knowing how many steps from the Demon to its nearest Minion.

courtier.description: Once per game, at night, choose a character: they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.
lore_desc: Once per game, at night, choose a character:
they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.

cultleader.description: Each night, you become the alignment of an alive neighbor. If all good players choose to join your cult, your team wins.

dreamer.description: Each night, choose another player: you learn 1 good & 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.
lore_desc: Each night: choose another player:
learn 1 good & 1 evil character,
1 of which is correct.

empath.description: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.
lore_desc: Each night, learn how many of
your alive neighbors are evil.

engineer.description: Once per game, at night, choose which Minions or which Demon is in play.

exorcist.description: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are and doesn't wake tonight.
lore_desc: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night):
the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are &
doesn't wake tonight

farmer.description: When you die at night, an alive good player becomes a Farmer.
lore_desc: When you die at night,
an alive good player becomes a Farmer.

fisherman.description: Once per game, you may ask the Storyteller for some advice to help your team win.
lore_desc: Once per game, you may ask the Storyteller
for some advice to help your team win.

flowergirl.description: Each night*, you learn if a Demon voted today.

fool.description: The 1st time you die, you don't.

fortuneteller.description: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.
lore_desc: Each night, choose 2 players:
you learn if either is a Demon.
There is a good player
that registers as a Demon to you.

gambler.description: Each night*, choose a player & guess their character: if you guess wrong, you die.
lore_desc: Each night*, choose a player & guess their character:
if you guess wrong, you die.

general.description: Each night, you learn which alignment the Storyteller believes is winning.
lore_desc: Each night, learn which alignment
the Storyteller believes is winning.

gossip.description: Each day, you may make a public statement. Tonight, if it was true, a player dies.
lore_desc: Each day, you make make a public statement.
Tonight, if it was true, a player dies.

grandmother.description: You start knowing a good player & their character. If the Demon kills them, you die too.
lore_desc: Start knowing a good player & their character.
If the Demon kills them, you die too.

highpriestess.description: Each night, learn which player the Storyteller believes you should talk to most.
lore_desc: Each night, learn which player
the Storyteller believes you should talk to most.

huntsman.description: Once per game, at night, choose a living player: the Damsel, if chosen, becomes a not-in-play Townsfolk. [+the Damsel]
lore_desc: Once per game, at night, choose a living player:
the Damsel, if chosen, becomes a not-in-play Townsfolk.
[+the Damsel]

innkeeper.description: Each night*, choose 2 players: they can't die tonight, but 1 is drunk until dusk.
lore_desc: Each night*, choose 2 players:
they can't die tonight, but 1 is drunk until dusk.

investigator.description: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.
lore_desc: Start knowing that 1 of 2 players
is a particular Minion.

juggler.description: On your 1st day, publicly guess up to 5 players' characters. That night, you learn how many you got correct.

king.description: Each night, if the dead equal or outnumber the living, you learn 1 alive character. The Demon knows you are the King.

knight.description: You start knowing 2 players that are not the Demon.
lore_desc: Start knowing 2 players
that are not the Demon.

librarian.description: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)
lore_desc: Start knowing that 1 of 2 players
is a particular Outsider.
(Or that zero are in play.)

lycanthrope.description: Each night*, choose an alive player. If good, they die & the Demon doesn't kill tonight. One good player registers as evil.

magician.description: The Demon thinks you are a Minion. Minions think you are a Demon.
lore_desc: The Demon thinks you are a Minion.
Minions think you are a Demon.

mathematician.description: Each night, you learn how many players' abilities worked abnormally (since dawn) due to another character's ability.
lore_desc: Each night, learn how many players' abilities
worked abnormally (since dawn) due to
another character's ability.

mayor.description: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.
lore_desc: If only 3 players live &
no execution occurs, your team wins.
If you die at night,
another player might die instead.

minstrel.description: When a Minion dies by execution, all other players are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
lore_desc: When a Minion dies by execution,
all other players are drunk until dusk tomorrow.

monk.description: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.
lore_desc: Each night*, choose another player:
they are safe from the Demon tonight.

nightwatchman.description: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they learn you are the nightwatchman.
lore_desc: Once per game, at night, choose a player:
they learn you are the nightwatchman.

noble.description: You start knowing 3 players, 1 and only 1 of which is evil.

oracle.description: Each night*, you learn how many dead players are evil.
lore_desc: Each night*, learn how many
dead players are evil.

pacifist.description: Executed good players might not die.

philosopher.description: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. If this character is in play, they are drunk.
lore_desc: Once per game, at night, choose a good character:
gain that ability.
If this character is in play, they are drunk.

pixie.description: You start knowing 1 in-play Townsfolk. If you were mad that you were this character, you gain their ability when they die.
lore_desc: Start knowing 1 in-play Townsfolk.
If you were mad that you were this character
gain their ability when they die.

poppygrower.description: Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, they learn who each other are that night.
lore_desc: Minions & Demons do not know each other.
If you die, they learn who each other are.

preacher.description: Each night, choose a player: a Minion, if chosen, learns this. All chosen minions have no ability.

princess.description: On your 1st day, if you nominated & executed a player, the Demon doesn't kill tonight.

professor.description: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.
lore_desc: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player:
if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.

ravenkeeper.description: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.
lore_desc: If you die at night, wake to choose a player:
learn their character.

sage.description: If the Demon kills you, you learn that it is 1 of 2 players.
lore_desc: If the Demon kills you,
learn that it is 1 of 2 players.

sailor.description: Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You can't die.

savant.description: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn 2 things in private: 1 is true & 1 is false.

seamstress.description: Once per game, at night, choose 2 players (not yourself): you learn if they are the same alignment.
lore_desc: Once per game, at night, choose 2 other players:
learn if they are the same alignment.

shugenja.description: You start knowing if your closest evil player is clockwise or anti-clockwise. If equidistant, this info is arbitrary.

slayer.description: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.
lore_desc: Once per game, publicly choose a player:
if they are the Demon, they die.

snakecharmer.description: Each night, choose an alive player: a chosen Demon swaps characters & alignments with you & is then poisoned.
lore_desc: Each night, choose an alive player:
a chosen Demon swaps characters & alignments
with you & is then poisoned.

soldier.description: You are safe from the Demon.

tealady.description: If both your alive neighbors are good, they can't die.

towncrier.description: Each night*, you learn if a Minion nominated today.

undertaker.description: Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.
lore_desc: Each night*, learn which character
died by execution today.

villageidiot.description: Each night, choose a player: you learn their alignment. [+0 to +2 Village Idiots. 1 of the extras is drunk]

virgin.description: The 1st time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately.
lore_desc: When you are 1st nominated,
if the nominator is a Townsfolk,
they are executed immediately.

washerwoman.description: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk.
lore_desc: Start knowing that 1 of 2 players
is a particular Townsfolk.

barber.description: If you died today or tonight, the Demon may choose 2 players (not another Demon) to swap characters.
lore_desc: If you died today or tonight
the Demon may choose 2 players (not another Demon) to swap characters.

butler.description: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.
lore_desc: Each night, choose another player:
tomorrow, you may only vote
if they are voting too.

damsel.description: All Minions know a Damsel is in play. If a Minion publicly guesses you (once), your team loses.
lore_desc: All Minions know a Damsel is in play.
If a Minion publicly guesses you (once),
your team loses.

drunk.description: You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are the Drunk.
lore_desc: You think you are a Townsfolk character
but you are the Drunk.

golem.description: You may only nominate once per game. When you do, if the nominee is not the Demon, they die.

goon.description: Each night, the 1st player to choose you with their ability is drunk until dusk. You become their alignment.
lore_desc: Each night, the 1st player to choose you
with their ability is drunk until dusk.
You become their alignment.

hatter.description: If you died today or tonight, the Minion & Demon players may choose new Minion & Demon characters to be.

heretic.description: Whoever wins, loses & whoever loses, wins, even if you are dead.

hermit.description: You have all Outsider abilities. [-0 or -1 Outsider]

klutz.description: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player: if they are evil, your team loses.
lore_desc: When you learn you died,
publicly choose 1 alive player:
if they are evil, your team loses.

lunatic.description: You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.
lore_desc: You think you are a Demon, but you are not.
The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.

moonchild.description: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player. Tonight, if it was a good player, they die.
lore_desc: When you learn you died,
publicly choose 1 alive player.
Tonight, if it was a good player, they die.

mutant.description: If you are "mad" about being an Outsider, you might be executed.
lore_desc: If you are "mad" about being an Outsider
you might be executed.

ogre.description: On your 1st night, choose a player (not yourself): you become their alignment (you don't know which) even if drunk or poisoned.
lore_desc: On your 1st night, choose another player:
become their alignment (you don't know which).

plaguedoctor.description: When you die, the Storyteller gains a Minion ability.

politician.description: If you were the player most responsible for your team losing, you change alignment & win, even if dead.

puzzlemaster.description: 1 player is drunk, even if you die. If you guess (once) who it is, learn the Demon player, but guess wrong & get false info.

recluse.description: You might register as evil & as a Minion or Demon, even if dead.
lore_desc: You might register as evil &
as a Minion or Demon, even if dead.

saint.description: If you die by execution, your team loses.

sweetheart.description: When you die, 1 player is drunk from now on.

tinker.description: You might die at any time.

zealot.description: If there are 5 or more players alive, you must vote for every nomination.

assassin.description: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die, even if for some reason they could not.
lore_desc: Once per game, at night*, choose a player:
they die, even if for some reason they could not.

baron.description: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]
lore_desc: There are two extra Outsiders in play.

boffin.description: The Demon (even if drunk or poisoned) has a not-in-play good character's ability. You both know which.
lore_desc: The Demon (even if drunk or poisoned)
has a not-in-play good character's ability.
You both know which.

boomdandy.description: If you are executed, all but 3 players die. After a 10 to 1 countdown, the player with the most players pointing at them, dies.
lore_desc: If you are executed, all but 3 players die.
All players then choose a player to kill -
The player with the most votes, dies.

cerenovus.description: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are "mad" they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.
lore_desc: Each night, choose a player & a good character:
they are "mad" they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.

devilsadvocate.description: Each night, choose a living player (different to last night): if executed tomorrow, they don't die.
lore_desc: Each night, choose a living player (different to last night):
if executed tomorrow, they don't die.

eviltwin.description: You & an opposing player know each other. If the good player is executed, evil wins. Good can't win if you both live.

fearmonger.description: Each night, choose a player: if you nominate & execute them, their team loses. All players know if you choose a new player.

goblin.description: If you publicly claim to be the Goblin when nominated & are executed that day, your team wins.
lore_desc: If you publicly claim to be the Goblin
when nominated & are executed that day,
your team wins.

godfather.description: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. If 1 died today, choose a player tonight: they die. [-1 or +1 Outsider]
lore_desc: Start knowing which Outsiders are in play.
If 1 died today, choose a player tonight: they die.
[-1 or +1 Outsider]

harpy.description: Each night, choose 2 players: tomorrow, the 1st player is "mad" that the 2nd is evil, or one or both might die.

marionette.description: You think you are a good character, but you are not. The demon knows who you are. [You neighbor the Demon]
lore_desc: You think you are a good character, but you aren't.
The demon knows who you are.
[You neighbor the Demon]

mastermind.description: If the Demon dies by execution (ending the game), play for 1 more day. If a player is then executed, their team loses.

mezepheles.description: You start knowing a secret word. The 1st good player to say this word becomes evil that night.

organgrinder.description: All players keep their eyes closes when voting and the vote tally is secret. Each night, choose if you are drunk until dusk.

pithag.description: Each night*, choose a player & a character they become (if not in play). If a Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
lore_desc: Each night*, choose a player &
a character they become (if not in play).
If a Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.

poisoner.description: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.
lore_desc: Each night, choose a player:
they are poisoned until dusk.

psychopath.description: Each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they die. If executed, you only die if you lose rock paper scissors.

scarletwoman.description: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon.
lore_desc: If there are 5 or more players alive
& the Demon dies, you become the Demon.

spy.description: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.
lore_desc: Each night, you see the Grimoire.
You might register as good &
as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.

summoner.description: You get 3 bluffs. On the 3rd night, choose a player: they become an evil Demon of your choice. [No Demon]

vizier.description: All players know you are the Vizier. You cannot die during the day. If good voted, you may choose to execute immediately.

widow.description: On your 1st night, look at the Grimoire & choose a player: they are poisoned. 1 good player knows a Widow is in play.

witch.description: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.
lore_desc: Each night, choose a player:
if they nominate tomorrow, they die.
If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.

wizard.description: Once per game, choose to make a wish. If granted, it might have a price and leave a clue as to its nature.
lore_desc: Once per game, choose to make a wish.
If granted, it might have a price and
leave a clue as to its nature.

wraith.description: You may choose to open your eyes at night. You wake when other evil players do.

xaan.description: On night X, all Townsfolk are poisoned until dust. [X Outsiders]

kazali.description: Kills each night*. [You choose which players are which Minions. -? to +? Outsiders]

imp.description: Kills each night*. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.
lore_desc: Kills each night*.
If you kill yourself this way,
a Minion becomes the Imp.

fanggu.description: Kills each night*. The 1st Outsider you kill becomes an evil Fang Gu & you die instead. [+1 Outsider]

alhadikhia.description: Each night*, you may choose 3 players (all players learn who): each privately chooses to live or die, but if all live, all die.

legion.description: Each night*, a player might die. Executions fail if only evil voted. You register as a Minion too. [Most players are Legion]

leviathan.description: If more than 1 good player is executed, evil wins. All players know you are in play. After day 5, evil wins.

lilmonsta.description: Each night, Minions choose who baysits Lil' Monsta & "is the Demon". Each night*, a player might die. [+1 Minion]

lleech.description: Kills each night*. You start by choosing a player: they are poisoned. You die if & only if they are dead.

lordoftyphon.description: Kills each night*. [Evil characters are in a line. You are in the middle. +1 Minion. -? to +? Outsiders.]
lore_desc: Kills each night*.
Evil characters are in a line.
You are in the middle.
+1 Minion, -? to +? Outsiders.

nodashii.description: Kills each night*. Your 2 Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned.

ojo.description: Each night*, choose a character: they die. If they are not in play, the Storyteller chooses who dies.
lore_desc: Each night*, choose a character: they die.
If they are not in play,
the Storyteller chooses who dies.

po.description: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no-one, choose 3 players tonight.
lore_desc: Each night*, you may kill a player.
If you last chose to kill no-one, kill 3 players tonight.

pukka.description: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.
lore_desc: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned.
The last poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.

riot.description: On day 3, Minions become Riot & nominees die but nominate an alive player immediately. This must happen.

shabaloth.description: Kills 2 players each night*. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.
lore_desc: Kills 2 players each night*. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.

vigormortis.description: Kills each night*. Minions you kill keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbor. [-1 Outsider]
lore_desc: Kills each night*. Minions you kill
keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbor.
[-1 Outsider]

vortox.description: Kills each night*. Townsfolk abilities yield false info. Each day, if no-one is executed, evil wins.
lore_desc: Kills each night*.
Townsfolk abilities yield false info.
Each day, if no-one is executed, evil wins.

yaggababble.description: You start knowing a secret phrase. For each time you said it publicly today, a player might die.

zombuul.description: Each night*, if no-one died today, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.
lore_desc: Each night*, if no-one died today, choose a player: they die.
The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.

apprentice.description: On your 1st night, you gain a townsfolk ability (if good), or a minion ability (if evil)
lore_desc: On your 1st night,
gain a townsfolk ability (if good)
or minion ability (if evil)

barista.description: Each night, until dusk, 1) a player becomes sober, healthy & gets true info, or 2) their ability works twice. They learn which.
lore_desc: Each night, until dusk, either
1) a player becomes sober, healthy & gets true info, or
2) their ability works twice.
They learn which.

beggar.description: You must use a vote token to vote. If a dead player gives you theirs, you learn their alignment. You are sober & healthy.
lore_desc: You must use a vote token to vote.
If a dead player gives you theirs,
learn their alignment.
You are sober & healthy.

bishop.description: Only the storyteller can nominate. At least 1 opposing player must be nominated each day.
lore_desc: Only the storyteller can nominate.
At least 1 opposing player must be nominated each day.

bonecollector.description: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: they regain their ability until dusk.
lore_desc: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player:
they regain their ability until dusk.

bureaucrat.description: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.
lore_desc: Each night, choose another player:
their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.

butcher.description: Each day, after the 1st execution, you may nominate again.
lore_desc: Each day, after the 1st execution,
you may nominate again.

cacklejack.description: Each day, choose a player: a different player changes character tonight.
lore_desc: Each day, choose a player:
another player changes character tonight.

deviant.description: If you were funny today, you cannot die by exile.

gangster.description: Once per day, you may choose to kill an alive neighbor, if your other alive neighbor agrees.
lore_desc: Once per day, you may choose
to kill an alive neighbor
if your other alive neighbor agrees.

gnome.description: All players start knowing a player of your alignment. You may choose to kill anyone who nominates them.
lore_desc: All players start knowing a player of your alignment.
You may choose to kill anyone who nominates them.

gunslinger.description: Each day, after the 1st vote has been tallied, you may choose a player that voted: they die.
lore_desc: Each day, after the 1st vote has been tallied,
you may choose a player that voted: they die.

harlot.description: Each night*, choose a living player: if they agree, you learn their character, but you both might die.
lore_desc: Each night*, choose a living player:
if they agree, you learn their character,
but you both might die.

judge.description: Once per game, if another player nominated, you may force the current execution to pass or fail.
lore_desc: Once per game, if another player nominated,
you may force the current execution to pass or fail.

matron.description: Each day, you may choose up to 3 sets of 2 players to swap seats. Players may not leave their seats to talk in private.
lore_desc: Each day, you may choose up to 3 sets of 2 players to swap seats.
Players may not leave their seats to talk in private.

scapegoat.description: If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.
lore_desc: If a player of your alignment is executed,
you might be executed instead.

thief.description: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts negatively tomorrow.
lore_desc: Each night, choose another player:
their vote counts negatively tomorrow.

voudon.description: Only you & the dead can vote. They don't need a vote token to do so. A 50% majority isn't required.
lore_desc: Only you & the dead can vote.
They don't need a vote token to do so.
A 50% majority isn't required.
